title: Noether normalization over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $B$ a commutative $k$-algebra of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] with $1\neq0$ in $B$. Then there are an integer $d\ge0$ and an injective homomorphism of $k$-algebras $\psi:k[Y_1,\ldots,Y_d]\to B$ from the polynomial ring in $d$ variables [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that $B$, regarded as a $k[Y_1,\ldots,Y_d]$-module through $\psi$, is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
